item.title: Paper: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
item.description: This framework improves 3D object placement by grounding AI agents in physical laws, helping developers create more realistic simulations and interactive digital environments.

item.title: Paper: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
item.description: This Bayesian approach helps data scientists dynamically select the best models in real-time streams while balancing prediction accuracy with fairness constraints.

item.title: Paper: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
item.description: This method uses a hierarchical architecture to efficiently fine-tune robotic manipulation tasks with minimal human intervention, making real-world deployment more practical.

item.title: Paper: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
item.description: This framework enables AI agents to master complex video games using synthetic experiences, reducing the reliance on massive sets of human gameplay demonstrations.

item.title: Paper: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
item.description: The authors show that using back-translation with monolingual data significantly improves machine translation performance in low-resource languages compared to relying solely on few-shot prompting or fine-tuning.

item.title: Paper: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
item.description: This paper introduces a method to improve agentic reinforcement learning by selectively injecting and evaluating relevant skills, reducing the computational cost and instability of traditional rollout-based credit assignment.

item.title: Paper: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description: The authors propose a framework that improves how LLM agents learn by assigning credit more intelligently across multi-turn actions, avoiding the pitfalls of uniform reward distribution without needing extra critic models.

item.title: Paper: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
item.description: By grouping robotic actions into chunks, this method reduces the redundant reasoning overhead of LLMs in control loops, making robot task execution significantly more efficient.

item.title: Paper: Same Query, Different Answer: Run-to-Run Variance in Semantic Query Processing
item.description: Researchers found that LLMs produce inconsistent results for the same query even at zero temperature, meaning data scientists must account for non-deterministic outputs in production pipelines.

item.title: Paper: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
item.description: This study analyzes how LLM attention heads adapt their roles based on specific task contexts, offering practitioners better insight into how model components influence final predictions.

item.title: Paper: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
item.description: The authors introduce a tool retrieval framework that uses real-time execution feedback to prioritize reliable tools, helping developers build more stable AI agent workflows.

item.title: Paper: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
item.description: This paper presents a red-teaming method to detect harmful outcomes in AI agents by systematically testing how different service interactions can lead to unintended consequences.

item.title: Paper: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
item.description: Researchers found that LLM agents effectively use experimental feedback to tune neural operators, outperforming traditional optimization methods for scientific modeling tasks.

item.title: Paper: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
item.description: A new probe-based monitoring system can detect hidden deception in LLM agents with high accuracy, providing a scalable way to improve AI safety and oversight.

item.title: Paper: Rounding in Preconditioner Space: Redesigning 4-bit AdamW Optimizer-State Quantization
item.description: This paper introduces a more stable 4-bit quantization method for AdamW optimizer states, helping data scientists reduce memory usage without sacrificing training convergence.

item.title: Paper: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
item.description: The authors introduce a new benchmark to test if vision-language models can predict how scenes change after interventions, moving beyond simple static image description.

item.title: Paper: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
item.description: The authors introduce a framework that moves beyond simple document retrieval by enabling models to compute and synthesize evidence across multiple sources, improving performance on complex reasoning tasks.

item.title: Paper: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
item.description: This research explores updating factual knowledge in LLMs by isolating it into a separate memory layer, allowing for targeted updates without needing to retrain the entire model.

item.title: Paper: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
item.description: This study evaluates how well current LLMs handle document-level text simplification in Estonian, providing insights for applying language models to low-resource, morphologically complex languages.

item.title: Paper: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
item.description: The researchers demonstrate that robotic world models follow predictable scaling laws, allowing practitioners to better estimate the compute and data needed to improve robot planning capabilities.
